availability_evidence: Annual report pages 79, 126, 138 and 180 state that the strategic report, responsibility statement and Group and Company financial statements were approved or authorised by the Board on 20 March 2024; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Adjusted revenue rose 6.3% at constant currency to £5,489m, adjusted operating profit rose 10% to £355m and adjusted margin expanded 30bps to 6.5%. Adjusted free cash flow was £93m and leverage improved to 1.4x from 1.5x at demerger, with net debt of £847m. Statutory operations recorded a £450m loss, principally a non-cash £449m Powder Metallurgy goodwill impairment after lower medium-term profit and cash assumptions. Restructuring costs rose to £120m and related cash outflow was £70m, but the manufacturing-footprint programme, Mosel and Roxboro closures, supply-chain changes and other actions were already announced or underway. Inflation and the UAW strike created headwinds, while order intake and management expectations remained positive.
already_announced_exclusion: The manufacturing-footprint programme, Mosel and Roxboro plant closures, Hungary and Mexico capacity actions, Powder Metallurgy footprint and automation measures, supply-chain restructuring, demerger actions and associated restructuring spend disclosed before report approval are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: A large statutory impairment, material restructuring spend and continuing inflation create meaningful pressure. Revenue, adjusted profit and margin growth, positive adjusted free cash flow, lower leverage, strong order intake and the fact that restructuring actions were already public provide strong contrary evidence.
